verdict.rationale: The product's source is publicly hosted on GitHub (moq-dev/moq), and a community author read the Rust code and had a fix PR merged, so the source is readable and open to contribution. Nothing in the pack names the license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g. MIT/Apache), first-party docs stating the licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: MoQ delivers WebRTC-like latency without the constraints of WebRTC.
Contributing to the moq-dev/moq repo: the author found the Rust code didn't close data streams before PUBLISH_DONE as draft-21 requires. His fix PR was merged by Luke Curley.
